budgets.description: Budgets is the current budget collection in the same shape PUT accepts.

limit_usd.description: LimitUSD is the per-period cap as a decimal string (e.g. "10.000000000").

period.description: Period is the calendar bucket: "day", "month", or "year".

scope.description: Scope is the principal tier: "user" or "group".

subject_id.description:
SubjectID is the opaque principal identifier: the directory platform user
UUID for a user budget, the directory group UUID for a group budget.
